## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `dev` (only release pull requests target `master`).
- [ ] `ruff format .`, `ruff check .` and `pytest` pass locally.
- [ ] New behaviour comes with a test.
- [ ] User-visible changes have an entry under "Unreleased" in CHANGELOG.md.
- [ ] If published numbers change: README.md and benchmarks/README.md are updated, and any
      tuning used the dev funds only.
